ecosystem_tools.name: wannado-wce Built-in Standards Physics & Traffic Kernel
ecosystem_tools.os_gpu_constraints: Cross-platform (CPU / CUDA / macOS); zero external build.
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Instant 3GPP/ITU/6G physics, differentiable baseband channels, traffic/MAC queues, and DRL/Adv handoff.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: Site-specific 3D CAD building ray tracing or real-time USRP C++ L1/L2/L3 protocol stacks.

ecosystem_tools.name: NVIDIA Sionna (PHY & SYS)
ecosystem_tools.install_command: pip install sionna-no-rt  # or `pip install sionna` with Ray Tracer
ecosystem_tools.os_gpu_constraints: Python >= 3.11 + PyTorch >= 2.9 recommended; Linux CUDA best for large batches.
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Full LDPC/Polar FEC chains, bit-level OFDM-MIMO BLER curves, and GPU-differentiable link simulation.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: Lightweight analytic/statistical baselines or TCP/IP packet-level network routing.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Wrap Sionna PHY blocks inside WirelessEnvInterface.channel_callable for bit-exact BLER evaluation.

ecosystem_tools.name: NVIDIA Sionna RT (3D Differentiable Ray Tracer)
ecosystem_tools.os_gpu_constraints: GPU OptiX ray tracing requires Linux + NVIDIA GPU; Windows/WSL2/macOS falls back to CPU.
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Site-specific 3D city/indoor building reflections, diffraction, and RIS electromagnetic ray tracing.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: Quick statistical 3GPP TR 38.901 Monte Carlo sweeps without 3D scene geometry.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Export ray paths/CIR from sionna.rt into ./wce_lab/cache/ and expose as WirelessEnvInterface tensors.

ecosystem_tools.name: DeepMIMO (v4+)
ecosystem_tools.os_gpu_constraints: Cross-platform Python; datasets download on demand (e.g., asu_campus_3p5).
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Standardized ray-traced MIMO, beam prediction, blockage, and localization benchmarks.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: Pure synthetic stochastic fading without geographic maps.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Load scenario channels via deepmimo.load() inside ./wce_lab/interface.py.

ecosystem_tools.name: QuaDRiGa (`quadriga-lib` C++/Python)
ecosystem_tools.language_backend: C++ core with native Python bindings
ecosystem_tools.os_gpu_constraints: Cross-platform Python wheels; no MATLAB license required.
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Continuous trajectory spatial consistency, calibrated antenna patterns, and QuaDRiGa ray-mesh generation.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: Pure PyTorch autograd backpropagation through channel synthesis.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Generate trajectory CIR arrays via quadriga_lib and convert to torch.complex64 inside ./wce_lab/.

ecosystem_tools.name: HermesPy (Barkhausen Institut)
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Multi-RAT link-level simulation, radar/ISAC sensing waveforms, and SDR hardware playback.

ecosystem_tools.name: TorchSig (PyTorch RF ML Toolkit)
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: AMC modulation classification, RF hardware impairments (IQ imbalance, PA nonlinearity), and RF datasets.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Pair TorchSig RF waveforms with wannado-wce channels and wannado-adv JSR attacks.

ecosystem_tools.name: py3gppchannels
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Reference full TR 38.901 SSP/LSP cluster generation cross-check.

ecosystem_tools.name: Scikit-CommPy
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Classic LDPC/Turbo/Convolutional coding, PSK/QAM modems, and textbook link benchmarks.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Use as classic FEC encoder/decoder front-end before wannado-wce channel layers.

ecosystem_tools.name: mobile-env (Gymnasium Mobile Network RL)
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Fast multi-BS cell selection / handover MARL prototyping.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: Detailed 3GPP TR 38.901 MIMO/OFDM physical layers (pair with wannado-wce blocks instead).

ecosystem_tools.name: NYUSIM Python (NYU WIRELESS)
ecosystem_tools.install_command: git clone https://github.com/nyu-wireless/NYUSIM_Python  # install per NYU WIRELESS release
ecosystem_tools.os_gpu_constraints: Cross-platform Python; specialized for FR1(C), FR3 (7-24 GHz), mmWave & sub-THz.
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Empirical NYC/outdoor measurement-validated FR3/mmWave/sub-THz spatial lobe channels.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: Sub-6 GHz standard 3GPP TR 38.901 compliance tests.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Pull into ./wce_lab/external/ and convert generated CIR snapshots into ChannelBatch.

ecosystem_tools.name: NVIDIA AI Aerial / pyAerial (cuPHY)
ecosystem_tools.os_gpu_constraints: Requires Linux + NVIDIA datacenter/RTX GPU + CUDA + Docker.
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Commercial-grade GPU 5G NR L1 PUSCH/PDSCH pipeline with PyTorch neural receiver plugins.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Generate ./wce_lab/jit_setup.sh container recipe when Linux+CUDA is detected.

ecosystem_tools.name: ns-3 + 5G-LENA (nr) + ns3-gym
ecosystem_tools.install_command: git clone https://gitlab.com/cttc-lena/nr.git && git clone https://github.com/tkn-tub/ns3-gym.git
ecosystem_tools.os_gpu_constraints: Linux / macOS C++ build toolchain (CMake, g++/clang, ZMQ, Protobuf); 15-40 min compile.
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Full TCP/UDP, PDCP, RLC, MAC scheduling, HARQ, and multi-hop packet delay evaluation.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: Differentiable PHY optimization or quick tensor experiments.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Emit isolated build recipe + ZMQ Gym bridge inside ./wce_lab/external/ns3/.

ecosystem_tools.name: OpenRAN Gym & ns-O-RAN
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: O-RAN Near-RT RIC xApp/dApp closed-loop KPM telemetry and E2 control evaluation.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: Pure PHY channel estimation or RIS beamforming math.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Generate O-RAN Docker compose + E2 bridge configuration inside ./wce_lab/external/.

ecosystem_tools.name: Simu5G (OMNeT++ / INET)
ecosystem_tools.install_command: git clone https://github.com/Unipisa/Simu5G.git  # inside OMNeT++ + INET workspace

ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: 5G NR user-plane, UPF/SMF 5GC, dual-connectivity, and V2X network-level scenarios.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Export .ini scenario & TR 38.901 parameters to Simu5G configs.

ecosystem_tools.name: OpenAirInterface (OAI 5G RAN + 5GC)
ecosystem_tools.os_gpu_constraints: Requires Ubuntu Linux low-latency kernel (+ USRP/RFsimulator); high RAM/CPU.
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Over-the-air 3GPP 5G NR hardware tests, RFsimulator digital twins, or FlexRIC xApps.
ecosystem_tools.when_not_to_use: macOS laptops or analytical Monte Carlo simulation.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Emit FlexRIC / RFsimulator parameter profiles from wce_spec.json.

ecosystem_tools.name: srsRAN Project (5G CU/DU/gNB) & FlexRIC
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Modular O-RAN split 7.2 / ZMQ virtual RF 5G gNB testbeds.
ecosystem_tools.fusion_with_wce_lab: Emit YAML gNB cell numerology & bandwidth config synced with TS 38.211.

ecosystem_tools.name: Vienna 5G Link & System Level Simulators
ecosystem_tools.when_to_use: Cross-validating existing MATLAB 5G system-level research pipelines.
